title: Vendor Invoice Audit Note: Charges Billed beyond the Daily Rate on Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Agency Payments
content:
**Charges billed beyond the daily rate.** These are the payment amount less its billed days multiplied by its billed daily rate. They are never below zero and are rounded to the cent.

**How much of those charges is allowed.** In auditing an agency payment under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the allowance depends on whether the option pays delivery and collection fees:

| Charges billed beyond the daily rate | Option pays delivery and collection fees | Allowed |
|---|---|---|
| Yes (more than zero) | Yes: 60/1800, 75/2250, 100/3000 | No more than $25.00 of those charges |
| Yes (more than zero) | No: 30/900, 40/1200, 50/1500 | None |
| None | Either | As billed (nothing) |

The allowed charges count toward what the agency should have been paid. Charges billed beyond the daily rate that are not allowed do not count toward it.

## Audit illustrations (hypothetical payments of 10 days at a $48.00 billed rate)

| Option | Payment amount | Charges beyond the daily rate | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 75/2250 | $520.00 | $40.00 | $25.00 |
| 60/1800 | $498.00 | $18.00 | $18.00 |
| 50/1500 | $520.00 | $40.00 | None |
| 100/3000 | $480.00 | None | Nothing |
